name: nhs_jobs-mcp
description: NHS Jobs (jobs): search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Keyless XML endpoint 'https://www.jobs.nhs.uk/api/v1/search_xml?' (spec v1.07). keyword matches 'the job title and job advert text'; page is 1-based ('Each page contains a maximum of 10 vacancies, unless specified otherwise by the "limit" parameter'; limit 'Maximum value 100'). location is not sent because the spec requires it together with distance and countryCode - filter locations client-side. id is the job reference (use it with get_posting); the numeric id, closeDate, salary (a text range such as '£20,000 to £30,000'), type and locations are in raw. totalPages / totalResults are in the response wrapper. The endpoint answers 406 Not Acceptable to the runtime's default Accept: application/json (live check 2026-09-26), so adapter.headers sends Accept: application/xml.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: jobReference: 'limit responses to only those job adverts with a matching Job reference number. If provided, then no other filter parameters will be used. This is used for exact matching to a job advert.' Pass the id returned by search (the job reference, e.g. A3233-26-0001).
